caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the evaluation of perplexity (PPL) values for two models, MoHD and Transformer, as a function of the number of sub-dimensions. The x-axis represents the number of sub-dimensions, ranging from 64 to 1632, with values increasing by 64 units and tick labels displayed every 64 units. The y-axis represents the PPL value in log scale, ranging from approximately 9.5 to 12.5, with a tick interval of 0.5. A blue solid line represents the PPL value for the MoHD model, starting at approximately 10.6 at 64 sub-dimensions and decreasing to approximately 10.3 at 1632 sub-dimensions. A red dashed line represents the PPL value for the Transformer model, beginning at approximately 11.5 at 64 sub-dimensions and remaining relatively constant at approximately 11.5 across the x-axis.
